scene: Awe-inspiring symbolic night sky above a silent desert: a vast glowing Milky Way and countless stars; high above, one huge luminous golden Islamic geometric star-and-lattice pattern made of pure light floats in the heavens like a celestial canopy, radiating soft golden rays down to the earth; far below, a quiet dark desert with dunes and a single tiny old clay oil lamp glowing. The LEFT 45 percent of the image is calm dark starry sky with no objects, kept empty for large text. Reverent, cinematic, high contrast, deep indigo and gold. Wide 16:9. No people, no text, no letters, no writing, no calligraphy.
